
**The following was generated by claude after looking through the ucap docs**

Cheat-sheet for raw UCAP (no AqFlow). For the full skill, see `aqflow-skills/skills/ucap-node-development/SKILL.md`.

## Transformations

| Type | Input | Output | Event builder needed | JSON output declaration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OneToOne` | one subscription → `FailSafeParameterValue` | `FailSafeParameterValue` or `None` | No (single `subscription` block) | `publishedProperty: "X"` |
| `OneToMany` | one subscription → `FailSafeParameterValue` | `list[FailSafeParameterValue]` | No | `publishedProperties: ["X","Y"]` |
| `EventToOne` | several subscriptions → `Event` | `FailSafeParameterValue` or `None` | Yes (declare `event.type`) | `publishedProperty: "X"` |
| `EventToMany` | several subscriptions → `Event` | `list[FailSafeParameterValue]` | Yes | `publishedProperties: ["X","Y"]` |

**Return-nothing convention:** `*ToOne` returns `None`; `*ToMany` returns `[]`. Filtering is normal.

## Event builders

| Builder                                  | Trigger                                                                  | Event content                                                        | Use when                                                                           |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `SubscriptionTriggered`                  | single triggering subscription                                           | trigger value + latest N of `bufferedSubscriptions`                  | One device drives timing, others give context                                      |
| `SubscriptionTriggeredCycleStampGrouped` | single trigger                                                           | trigger + matching subscriptions whose cycle stamps match + buffered | Same, but also need cycle-aligned companions                                       |
| `SubscriptionTriggeredFieldGrouped`      | single trigger                                                           | trigger + matching subs whose configured field matches + buffered    | Same, but matched on a field value (e.g. SUPERCYCLE_NB)                            |
| `GroupTriggeredCycleStampGrouped`        | `triggerGroup` of subs, all with matching cycle stamp **or** `timeoutMs` | grouping subs + buffered                                             | Need *all* of several devices aligned by cycle; tolerate missing data with timeout |
| `GroupTriggeredAcquisitionStampGrouped`  | as above but matched by acq stamp                                        | ↳                                                                    | Devices use acq stamp, not cycle stamp                                             |
| `GroupTriggeredFieldGrouped`             | as above but matched by field value                                      | ↳                                                                    | Match on a domain-specific field                                                   |
| `CombiningLatestValues`                  | any input                                                                | latest N values of every subscription                                | Snapshot all latest values as fast as possible; converter handles staleness        |
| `ForwardedSubscriptions`                 | any input                                                                | only the single value that just arrived                              | Process each subscription independently                                            |
| `FixedIntervalTriggered`                 | Java timer, every N ms                                                   | latest N buffered values                                             | Periodic aggregation, housekeeping (not cycle-accurate)                            |
| `Scheduled`                              | cron expression                                                          | latest N buffered values                                             | Daily/weekly/etc. jobs                                                             |

## Subscription configuration

| Field | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `parameter` | required | `DEVICE/Property` or `DEVICE/Property#field` (subscribe to a single field) |
| `selector` | none | **Required for PPM** (`SPS.USER.SFTPRO1`, wildcards OK). **Forbidden for non-PPM**. |
| `alias` | parameter name | Name used in `event.get_value("alias")` |
| `bufferSize` | 1 | Number of latest values to retain |
| `timestampSortType` | `NO_SORTING` | `ACQ_STAMP` / `CYCLE_STAMP` — sort buffer (rejects late values when full) |
| `ignoreErrors` | false | Drop FSPVs carrying `ParameterException` before they reach the converter |
| `ignoreFirstUpdates` | false | Drop the cached first-update; do not set for rarely-publishing sources (settings) |
| `type` | (omit) | `INTERNAL` (other converter via `publish_internally_async`) or `ACTOR` (actor feedback) |

## PPM / non-PPM rule

| Property kind | Examples | Selector |
|---|---|---|
| **PPM** (cycle-bound) | `*/Acquisition`, `*/Waveform`, `*/AnalyserResults`, `*/SamplesFromTrigger` | **MUST** carry `selector` |
| **non-PPM** (state-machine) | `*/Status`, `*/Setting`, `*/ScopeCardInfo` | **MUST NOT** carry `selector` |

Mismatch ⇒ FEC rejects with `ACCESS_POINT_NEEDS_SELECTOR` or `ACCESS_POINT_REFUSES_SELECTOR`. **Both errors are silent on the Python side** — they appear only in the Java node logs (`podman logs <cid> | grep ACCESS_POINT_`). Output of a PPM-driven transformation is itself PPM — subscribers must use a matching selector.

## Converter context (available in `convert()`)

| `*ToOne` | `*ToMany` |
|---|---|
| `device_name` | `device_name` |
| `transformation_name` | `transformation_name` |
| `published_property_name` | `published_property_names` |
| `published_parameter_name` | `published_parameter_names` |
| `configuration` (dict from JSON) | `configuration` |

Class-based: `self.configuration`. Function-based: `from ucap.common.context import configuration` (no aliasing on the import).

## Event API

| Call | Returns |
|---|---|
| `event.trigger_value` | trigger's `FailSafeParameterValue` (`SubscriptionTriggered*` only) |
| `event.trigger_name` | trigger's alias |
| `event.get_value("alias")` | latest FSPV for alias |
| `event.get_values("alias")` | all buffered FSPVs, oldest → newest |
| `event.get_value("alias@selector")` | bufferedBySelector lookup |
| `event.get_plain_value("alias", "field")` | unpack to Python scalar; raises `ValueError` if missing |
| `event.timeout_reached` | True ⇒ partial event (Group* builders) |
| `event.missing_value_names` | names whose data didn't arrive |

## ValueType (RDA3 types)

| Python | Default RDA3 type | Override |
|---|---|---|
| `int` | `INT` (32-bit) | `ValueType.LONG` for 64-bit |
| `float` | `DOUBLE` | `ValueType.FLOAT` for 32-bit |
| `bool` | `BOOL` | — |
| `str` | `STRING` | — |
| `list[...]` | corresponding 1D array | — |
| `list[list[...]]` | 2D array | — |

Auto-typed: scalars + 1D/2D arrays of int/float/bool/str, `DiscreteFunction`, `DiscreteFunctionList`.

## Device-definition top-level

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ucap-docs.web.cern.ch/device_schema.json",
  "ucapJsonSchemaVersion": "v3",
  "name": "SPS.MY.DEVICE",
  "description": "...",
  "transformations": [ ... ],
  "actors": [ ... ],
  "settableProperties": [ ... ]
}
```

| Optional device-level field | Effect |
|---|---|
| `firstUpdatesEnabled: false` | Disable per-selector first-update cache (saves heap) |
| `ccsManaged: true` | UCAP creates/deletes the CCS device; needs `deviceClassName`, `deviceClassVersion`, `responsible` |
| `cycleBound`, `ppm`, `timingDomain`, `accelerator`, `accZone` | CCS metadata |
| `startupPolicy` | `FAIL_FAST` (default) or `FAIL_SAFE` |
